Strategy 5 — Standard Setup (daily, Nifty 50)

On this page

  1. Indicators (daily chart)
  2. Buy (at the day's close, all four true that day)
  3. Sell (the first of these)
  4. Money
  5. Test results (all 50 Nifty 50 stocks, 1 Jan 2023 – 26 Oct 2026, FYERS charges)

The setting that held up best across all Strategy 5 tests (Oct 2026). Education, not investment advice. Evidence: strategy5_roc_ema_sweep.md and ../../../projects/trading-equation-backtests/reports/STRATEGY5_*_REPORT.md.

Indicators (daily chart)

IndicatorSettingsLook for
Rate of Change (ROC)Length 20, source closeabove 7 (add a line at 7)
EMALength 50, source closethe day's close above it
MACDFast 12, slow 26, signal 9, source closehistogram bar bigger than the day before
Stochastic RSIK 3, D 3, RSI length 14, stochastic length 14, source closeblue crosses above orange, blue below 50 (add a line at 50)

Buy (at the day's close, all four true that day)

  1. ROC(20) > 7 → the stock is up more than 7% over the last 20 trading days
  2. Close above the 50-day EMA
  3. MACD histogram bigger than yesterday's (green growing or red shrinking)
  4. Stoch RSI blue crosses above orange today (yesterday blue ≤ orange) with blue below 50

Delivery (CNC), ₹1,00,000 per trade (shares = ₹1,00,000 ÷ price), one trade at a time per stock.

Sell (the first of these)

  • Blue touches orange on a later day: sell then (during the day as soon as it touches; at the open if it opens there)
  • Optional stop-loss: the low of the day you bought (about 2% below the buy price). Same total profit in the test, but it cut event-day crashes (e.g. 4 Jun 2024: NTPC −₹15.7k → −₹5.0k).

No target. A trade usually lasts about a week; trades that last 7+ days make almost all the profit.

Money

  • ₹1 lakh per stock; several stocks can be open at once (up to 13 in the test, usually 1–3).
  • About ₹5 lakh gave the best return (≈ 6% a year in the test). With ₹1–2 lakh it lost money.
  • FYERS charges ≈ ₹283 per trade (mostly STT).

Test results (all 50 Nifty 50 stocks, 1 Jan 2023 – 26 Oct 2026, FYERS charges)

Beats random buys with the same ROC/EMA filter in 97% of runs. Daily only: on 4-hour and 1-hour the same setting breaks even or loses. Settings were chosen after seeing 2025–26, so paper-trade first or test on Nifty 200.
